validation_tools.name: Product catalog standalone content checker
requirements: Product IDs are unique and nonempty.
Display names remain fictional and avoid forbidden real-world brand or product fragments.
Required production inventory schema fields are present on every product resource.
Category coverage includes used games, new games, accessories, hardware, and service tickets.
Pricing data stays positive and suggested price remains between cost basis and market value.
The catalog has enough total and sellable products for a multi-day starter loop.
Data-driven visual variant coverage includes case, disc, cartridge, accessory, console, controller, box, sealed, loose, and service-ticket forms.
